vocabulary.meaning: the system of linked pages and resources accessed over the internet
examples: The article gave a clear example of World Wide Web.
We discussed World Wide Web during the session.

vocabulary.meaning: a clickable connection that takes a user from one digital page or resource to another
examples: Many people have strong opinions about hyperlink.
Understanding hyperlink helped me follow the discussion.

vocabulary.meaning: software used to access and view websites
examples: Browser was one of the key ideas in the article.
I used the term browser when explaining my opinion.

vocabulary.meaning: a collection of related web pages available under one domain
examples: The speaker described how website can affect people's lives.
Our group talked about the advantages and disadvantages of website.

vocabulary.meaning: the global network of connected computers and digital systems
examples: The discussion made me think more carefully about internet.
Different countries may have different experiences with internet.

vocabulary.meaning: a single document or page viewed through a web browser
examples: I had heard of web page before, but I did not fully understand it.
After the lesson, I could explain web page in my own words.
